notes.title: Improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Buttons have been added to return to the menu and exit the game.
Options have been added for you to take the initial conversations and during the game (Separately)
Now the AWSD control model works to make the tutorial (Mouse too)
Pressing the "E" button does not make you leave the game anymore.
And some minor bugs have also been fixed.

notes.title: General Game Improvements
notes.notes:
Added large shot mechanics from the player.
Added information in the tutorial area.
Upon request, the ESC key now serves as a pause.
correction of flaws in the translation at the end of the game.
Dialogues added every 100 points, thus revealing a little of the game's history.
addition of new trailler.

notes.title: Bug fixing and adding mechanics
notes.notes:
Removed the option to pause the song by the letter M due to too many conflicts with other scripts.

Addition of the jump to the middle mouse button.

notes.title: UI fixes and option additions for gameplay
notes.notes:
Some words in menus have been slightly modified to a more simplified language.

The mouse now works to shoot and activate the ground:

Left side: Shoot.
Right side: Activates the floor.

A mute option has also been added for background music, to mute and unmute just click "M".
